Welcome to our Hot Pot restaurant! The experience offers a realistic visit to a hot pot restaurant, based in Hong Kong.

Q: What is Hot Pot?
A: Hot pot is popular across Asia. Ingredients are served raw and then cooked with boiling broth in a pot. It is enjoyed once cooked.
